system.biography:
A slender, wiry man of middle height with brown skin and shock-white dreadlocks. Born a bastard child in the Varang City-States, adopted by the Three Devils Gang, he Exalted as a Twilight Caste Solar when he took sanctuary in a shrine of the Unconquered Sun. Seduced by demons he summoned in his quest for vengeance and knowledge, he eventually turned akuma to Cecelyne. Now serves as the operator of the Last Supplicant of Endless Power (the Penitent statue at the Lap) for the Empress's forces.

Aspect/Caste: Twilight Solar (akuma, Cecelyne). Source: Return of the Scarlet Empress.
